Apache-2.0

A pure-JS decoder: raw image bytes in, a payload out. The GifOS wrap never
opens a live camera stream (the sandbox does not hand apps WebRTC /
getUserMedia). A picture arrives from gifos.takePhoto (brokered, OS chrome)
or from a dropped / picked file, then jsQR reads it.

History of decoded text is saved privately. Upstream's demo page uses a live
video stream — that path is not here.
